      Saved work

      Where each kind of work is kept.

      Grades

      Scores you enter in Grading save to your grading sheet. If a save cannot be confirmed, your entries are kept as a recovery draft in this browser until you retry; a draft is not a saved grade.

      Daily update

      Notes you save go straight into your tab of the month’s Daily Update Sheet. Notes you have not saved yet stay in this browser until you save or discard them.

      Homework sheets

      Your class setups are kept in this browser. Edits to a sheet stay on the page until you print or copy it. A Hakwon Sarang upload confirmation for a weekly sheet is saved with the grading sheet.

      In this browser

      In this sample, reminder completion and daily grades stay in this browser on this device.

      In this browser

      In this sample, reminder completion, daily grades and PSM comments stay in this browser on this device.

      Recruitment

      Candidate profiles and original resumes stay in the connected Drive archive.

      Your reminders

      Reminder completion stays in this browser on this device.

      Materials and templates

      Template edits stay in this tab. Download your finished work before closing it.

      Shared files

      There is no shared, account-based library yet. Work kept in a browser does not follow you to another device.

        Comparatives & superlatives

        40 minutes
        01Warm-up5 min

        Compare two familiar objects. Explain your choice.

        02Teach8 min
        Two worked examples: heavier than, and the tallest. Ask learners to explain the difference.
        03Practice12 min
        Correct an EDE passage, then explain each change with a partner.
        04Apply10 min
        Compare three objects. Make and defend a choice using both forms.
        05Check & close5 min
        One exit sentence and one explanation. Link the approved homework here.
